mode: Built-in image generation; two new transparent raster assets

assets.purpose: Static chairs, contact shadows, stone pit and ember bed on one ground plane

deliveryOptimization: Original generated transparent PNGs retained in private evidence. Browser canvas resized the camp and cropped transparent flame margins for WebP delivery. No creative raster editing outside image generation.
sharedPrompt: Fine detailed painterly game-environment illustration, semi-realistic materials, like a lush Korean Joseon palace mountain garden painting viewed at blue-hour dusk. Not flat vector, not pixel art, not studio product photography. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no text.
campPromptSuffix: Create a small foreground cutout of exactly two modest low folding camping chairs facing inward toward a small circular stone fire pit between them. Muted dark olive fabric, slender dark weathered wood frames, credible construction, camera looking down about 30 degrees. All on one ground plane: left chair angles diagonally right, right chair diagonally left. Pit centred at x50%, lower y78%; charcoal and short logs with subtle orange ember bed but NO open flames, which will be animated separately. Cool dim blue evening light, restrained warm ember reflections on inner fabric/legs. Soft dark contact shadows touch every foot and the pit. Compact landscape 3:2 composition fully inside canvas, transparent margin around all objects. No floor rectangle, no grass, no pond, no scenery, no people, no characters, no lanterns. Believable small quiet camp; firepit lower than seats; delicate antialiased edges.
flamePromptSuffix: Create ONLY one small natural campfire-flame cluster as a transparent overlay. Several asymmetric thin irregular orange-gold flame tongues with wispy tapered tips, amber base and restrained pale yellow core; a short modest campfire from elevated 30 degree view, to fit a small stone firepit. Not a light bulb, smooth cone, torch or icon. Painterly translucent flame edges; remains attractive and legible at 25-35px tall. Flame centre canvas, baseline y85%; glow extremely restrained near flame. NO wood, stones, furniture, smoke cloud, ground or shadow.
privacy: The supplied iPhone photo was inspected privately. No photograph or personal identity was included in this repository. Public QA uses synthetic identity and API responses.
